raw.details:
Overview

“Innovate. Build. Break Boundaries.”

E-Cell LNCTE presents HACKxCRAFT, a 6-house house-based coding challenge designed to bring together innovators, developers, and problem-solvers to transform ideas into impactful solutions.

HACKxCRAFT is a two-round coding competition where participants first showcase their existing projects and compete for a place in their respective innovation houses. Shortlisted teams then face a common problem statement in an intense 6-hour on-campus coding challenge, where they must build a functional solution from scratch.

Bring your ideas, demonstrate your coding skills, and prove your ability to innovate under pressure.

Important Details:

  • Team Size: Exactly 6 Members
  • Registration: No fixed limit on the number of teams.
  • Competition Format: 2 Rounds
  • Round 1: Existing Project Submission (PDF)
  • Round 2: 6-Hour On-Campus Coding Challenge
  • House Categories: 6 Innovation Houses
  • Shortlisting: Top 6 teams from each house
  • Finalists: 36 Teams (6 Houses × 6 Teams)
  • Venue: LNCT Group of Colleges, Bhopal

House Categories:

HACKxCRAFT will feature six innovation houses representing different technology and innovation domains.

  • SaaS House
  • FinTech House
  • AgriTech House
  • Generative AI House
  • Student Innovation House
  • [Sixth House – To Be Announced]

Important: Participants do not need to select or register under a specific house beforehand. House allocation will be done by the organizing team based on the domain and theme of the project submitted in Round 1.

For example:

  • A financial management or digital payment solution will be considered under FinTech.
  • An agriculture-based technology solution will be considered under AgriTech.
  • An AI-powered application will be considered under Generative AI.

The organizing team will evaluate and assign each project to its most relevant house.

Competition Structure:

ROUND 1 – Project Showcase & House Allocation:

Participants must submit an existing project through a single PDF document containing complete information about their project.

The PDF should include:

  • Project Title
  • Team Name and Details of All 6 Members
  • Problem Statement / Problem Identification
  • Proposed Solution
  • Project Overview and Description
  • Key Features and Functionalities
  • Technology Stack Used
  • Project Architecture or Workflow (if applicable)
  • GitHub Repository Link (if available)
  • Live Project / Deployment Link (if available)
  • Demo Video Link (if available)
  • Screenshots of the Working Project

Submission Guidelines:

  • Participants can submit an existing project based on any of the six house themes.
  • The project must be submitted in a single PDF document.
  • GitHub, live demo, and other relevant project links must be included in the PDF wherever available.
  • Projects will be evaluated based on innovation, technical implementation, feasibility, and relevance to the respective house theme.
  • The organizing team will assign each project to the appropriate house based on its domain.
  • Participants do not need to select a house during registration.
  • The top 6 teams from each house will qualify for Round 2.

Selection: 36 teams in total (6 teams from each of the 6 houses) will qualify for the final round.

ROUND 2 – HACKxCRAFT: The 6-Hour Coding Challenge:

The 36 shortlisted teams will compete in an intensive 6-hour on-campus coding challenge at LNCT Group of Colleges, Bhopal.

Problem Statement (PS):

  • A common problem statement will be provided to all 36 shortlisted teams.
  • The problem statement will be revealed instantly at the beginning of the final round.
  • Every team will work on the same problem statement.
  • Teams must develop their solutions collaboratively within the allotted 6 hours.

Development Guidelines:

  • Projects must be developed from scratch after the official announcement of the problem statement.
  • Previously completed projects or pre-built solutions cannot be submitted as the final-round solution.
  • Teams must develop a functional working prototype or Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
  • Participants can use their technical skills and creativity to build the most effective solution within the given time.

Final Round Submission Requirements:

Every team must submit the following before the official deadline:

  • Project Title and Team Details
  • Problem Understanding and Proposed Solution
  • Project Description
  • Source Code / GitHub Repository Link
  • Working Prototype or MVP
  • Short Presentation (PPT)
  • Demo Video or Screenshots (as backup, if required)

Late submissions may attract penalties or disqualification.

Judging Criteria (100 Marks):

  • Innovation & Creativity: 20 Marks
  • Functionality & Working Prototype: 25 Marks
  • Technical Implementation: 20 Marks
  • Problem-Solving Approach: 15 Marks
  • UI/UX & User Experience: 10 Marks
  • Presentation & Demonstration: 10 Marks
  • Total: 100 Marks

Rules & Regulations:

  • Each team must consist of exactly 6 members.
  • There is no fixed registration limit on the number of teams.
  • Participants can submit projects from any of the six house themes.
  • House allocation will be decided by the organizing team based on the submitted project's domain.
  • Each team must submit its project details in a single PDF document.
  • Only the top 6 teams from each house will qualify for the final round.
  • A total of 36 teams will participate in the final coding challenge.
  • Finalist teams must retain their registered members. Any changes require prior approval from the organizers.
  • All shortlisted teams will receive the same common problem statement at the beginning of Round 2.
  • Final-round projects must be developed from scratch after the official problem statement announcement.
  • Previously completed projects or pre-built solutions cannot be submitted as final-round projects.
  • All submissions must be original. Plagiarism or violation of competition guidelines may result in disqualification.
  • Teams must complete their submissions within the specified deadlines.
  • Organizers reserve the right to disqualify teams violating the competition rules.
  • The judges' decision will be final and binding.

Be Ready to Innovate!

Showcase what you have already built, earn your place among the best, and take on a completely new coding challenge.

Build your team. Represent your house. Conquer the challenge.

HACKxCRAFT – Where Ideas Meet Execution!

IMPORTANT NOTE:

If selected for the final round, participants will be required to pay an attendance fee (amount to be announced later) to secure their physical presence at the three-day event. The fee is solely for attending the event, and payment is mandatory
